title: Review: fragment.rs edge cases 2026-08-16
description:

Review confidence: 85% chance of missed bug.

- Complex bitmap manipulation in ACK encoding/decoding (lines 264-300, 351-391)
- Window boundary logic in multi-window transmissions
- Interaction between finalize() and receive_all1() state transitions

Would raise confidence if:
- Fuzzing with arbitrary wire bytes
- Property-based tests for round-trip invariants
- Coverage report showing all error branches exercised

Summary:
- P0: 0 findings
- P1: 0 findings
- P2: 5 findings (dead code, masking fallback, overflow bounds)
- P3: 2 findings (unreachable code, missing docs)

Notable: Code has good defensive checks overall. Most edge cases are handled. No unsafe blocks. Error types use #[non_exhaustive]. The main risks are maintenance burdens and future-proofing, not current correctness bugs.
